one_liner: Issue and project tracking software for software development teams (Atlassian).

auth.evidence_quote: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) allows external applications and services to access Atlassian product APIs on a user's behalf.
auth.notes: Also supports API tokens (basic auth with email:token) for single-account scripts.

access.evidence_quote: Users trying to install an unapproved OAuth 2.0 integration are warned that the app has not yet been reviewed by Atlassian.
access.notes: Free Atlassian developer/cloud site available; OAuth apps distributed beyond installer's own instance need approval to avoid the unreviewed-app warning.

api.evidence_quote: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps can be listed on the Atlassian Marketplace
api.notes: Jira Cloud REST API is large (broad by general knowledge); Atlassian has published a remote MCP server covering Jira/Confluence.

verdict.rationale: Free developer access and mature OAuth2 REST API, but distributing an app to arbitrary customers triggers Atlassian's review/warning process.
